usage: POI terrain, rendered continuously per room; Celestium paths and fog are runtime layers.

prompts.cave: Use case stylized-concept. Production game terrain texture for Adams Haven Unity top-down dungeon, cave POI in Silverbrook Forest. One square seamless tileable material swatch filling the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge: rugged slate rock, pebbles and earth, subtle pale silverwood roots. Orthographic directly overhead flat view, painterly detailed fantasy game art, cool blue-silver ambient light. POI material dominates, silverwood accents secondary. Even lighting and scale, readable quiet center, small natural variation. NO room layout, no walls, no paths, no border, no perspective, no characters, no text, no UI, no grids, no labels. Celestium path glow will be drawn separately by the game; do not bake bright route lines into this texture. Save image for cave_terrain.png.
